_doc: Paladin line (spec #308, ticket P2 #310). The second class line after Hero: a class spec adds jobs/<line>.json, skills/<line>.json (empty skeleton until its tickets define skills) and asset_manifest.d/<line>.json (P1 #309), automatically discovered by DataRepo.lines() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Skill keys stay inert until their definitions exist in skills/paladin.json (or skills/hero.json for power_strike and slash_blast): an undefined key is never offered. The AP row lives in this file's balance block. P9 (#317) flipped playable; default_job stays 212.

122._starting_skill: tier C: spec #308: the fast filler, slot 1; defined by Hero's skills/hero.json (not edited here).
122._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #308 D1: Rush (WZ 1221007) is Paladin's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; defined by P4 #312.
122._skill_pool: tier C: spec #308 (skill pool table): eight entries for six slots. power_strike and slash_blast are Hero's definitions; blast, monster_magnet_paladin and the four Charges are defined by P5 (#313), P7 (#315) and P8 (#316). Charged Blow and Heaven's Hammer are sub-skills of the Charges, not pool entries.
122._weapon_families: tier C: spec #308: one- and two-handed swords and blunt weapons (WeaponInfo.family), the Paladin's weapons; axe, spear and polearm never drop. Armour and shields drop by the Warrior class bit.
122._creation_weapon: tier A: the Mace (Item.wz 1322000, reqJob 3 includes the Warrior bit; the level requirement is gone with #292). Already in the Warrior manifest fragment.
122._provenance: tier C: spec #308 P9 #317: the selection ticket flips playable (P2 #310 kept the job data-only until its skills, Forms and bot were in); default_job stays 212.

hub_kit._hub_kit: tier C: spec #308 P9 #317: the --hub test kit. The fixture is paladin_t2.json; the 20 scroll stacks are the ATT scrolls (100%, 60%, 10%, dark 70% and 30%) of the sword, blunt, two-handed sword and two-handed blunt families (scrolls/warrior.json), the Paladin's four weapon kinds; the spares are a hat, a Sword (1302008, Lv30), a one-handed blunt weapon (1322014, Lv30), gloves and a top; fallback_item is the Lv40 sword (1302009) the flow driver wears when no Lv40-plus piece dropped.

122._hp: tier C #346 (orchestrator ruling for melee jobs, as Dark Knight did): Hero's melee starting HP, copied from jobs/hero.json; training seeds only, GAME_DESIGN 4.2. P2 argued for the shared default; the balance pass owns it.
122._ap: tier C: spec #308 (Job data): the Hero 112 row's shape, STR primary, DEX secondary, DEX ~ level + 4 at the keyframes. Starting HP and HP growth are Hero's (hp 600, growth 65 below), P9.

122._hp: tier C #346 (orchestrator ruling, as Dark Knight): Hero's melee HP growth per level, copied from jobs/hero.json; GAME_DESIGN 4.2. The Warrior line's 26 stays in the 100 row.
